description: Add a custom topic (a free-text offering such as "Pet insurance for senior dogs") to the brand's Deep AI Dive topic menu. Requires PRO+. Free and instant — it does not start a run or draft questions. Limits: label 2-80 characters, description up to 200 (defaults to the label), max 10 custom topics per brand. This only adds the topic to the menu (selected=false), so the next run will NOT ask about it yet. To put it into the next run, call ai_visibility_topic_include afterwards (add every topic first, then include them all in one call).

description.description: One line on what counts as on-topic (max 200). Defaults to the label.

name: ai_visibility_topic_add
